compare_reference.description: For an explicitly selected Fiji Analyze Particles run, compare with its ImageJ macro on the same input and generation. Agreement is not accuracy.

of.description: a population id (e3) or "@n", to count its members

what.description: what to find (for "concept": the thing's name alone)

inside.description: object id, "target N", or a label

like.description: every thing like this outlined one ("find all like this", "the others like it"): object id or "that"

all.description: true: every match; false: one; omitted: the vision model follows the quantity in the original request

keep_container.description: default true; false replaces only the app-drawn inside outline after a successful find, preserving user outlines

by.description: "look" (default), "cells", or "concept" (SAM 3.1 matches the words; on these slides an example works better)

anyOf.description: An exact retained capability input from the input picker; never a preview URL or latest revision.
Choose a saved single-plane uint8 intensity image with Y/X axes (at most one megapixel); other types need an explicit conversion.

params.description: its parameters by id with the values the user asked for, as its description lists them; one left out is its default

by.description: who chose to run it: the user's own request, or you (optional: brain)
